kn5000-44c: Wave 4 (open4/kn5000-b-hdae), repo side done; leave open until the docs lane publishes. All three open questions of hdae5000-filesystem.md are answered from the code: (1) the song record holds 10 part-present flags at +26+k (1 saved / 0 deleted, set by each HDAE5000_SaveSong_<part>, cleared by DeleteSongPart_<part>) and 10 first-cluster slots at +36+4k; parts 0-8 = LSW PMT SQT CMP TM MSP RCM MD TLX; flag +35 and slot +72 are written only by a format (spare); v1.x has 8 parts. (2) FLS item bytes +80/+112 are the manual's AS (AUTO START) and AL (AUTO LOAD) options: edit switches 6/7, '*' in the lists, AS presses the sequencer start after loading, AL arms the chain that loads the next item 0x53 ticks after the sequencer stops. (3) 'FSB' is the whole table set: commands 03/06 load/store all 323 table sectors, 04/05 move blocks 0, 1 and 2. Renamed in all four HD-AE5000 trees: HDAE5000_FlsItem_SetAutoStart/SetAutoLoad, HDAE5000_Fls_GetAutoLoadPending/SetSeqStopPending, HDAE5000_RAM_FlsChainFls/FlsChainItem/FlsAutoLoadPending/FlsSeqStopPending. Website page draft: notes/open4-kn5000-b/hdae/README.md, section 'kn5000-44c' -> 'Website page draft (hdae5000-filesystem.md)'.
kn5000-t8n: Wave 4 (open4/kn5000-b-hdae), repo side done; leave open until the docs lane publishes. The PC-link packet is verified for all 20 commands: 256-byte packets + u32 byte sum + EndBlock; request byte 0 = command (1-20; 0 is not rejected), bytes 1-4 = dir/song/mask lo/mask hi for 07-09, 11, 14, 16, command-specific fields for 01, 10, 11, 13, 20; replies are byte ranges of HDAE5000_RAM_PportInfoBlock at the same offsets with byte 255 = 0xFF on failure. The info block layout (+0x2C block descriptors, +0x46 nine 9-byte part records, +0x97 geometry, +0xBF TLX record, +0xC8 file-format version) and a per-command table of services, replies and transfers are in the README. The website's 'older reading' was the reply of commands 09/14 (mask in bytes 0-1, nine part SIZES from +0x2C, not sector addresses). Probe: notes/open4-kn5000-b/hdae/probes/pport_packet_map.py. Services 18 and 27 named (Svc18_RequestNormalMode, Svc27_DeleteSongParts). Website page draft: notes/open4-kn5000-b/hdae/README.md, section 'kn5000-t8n'.
kn5000-e7f: Wave 4 (open4/kn5000-b-hdae), repo side done; leave open until the docs lane publishes. Command 20 (v2.x only) traced: service 29 (RootFn_SleepMainTask), receive request+2 bytes into work DRAM 0x010000, service 28 calls SRAM 0x23FEB0 with XWA=0x10000 and the descriptor {'XAP', &count, 0x280000, 0x2F0000}, service 30 (RootFn_WakeUpMainTask), 'End Flash Right' when the call returns 0x58. No version or data check (the link's only version check is command 01's). Caveat, with evidence: nothing in any HD-AE5000, main-CPU, table-data or custom-data image puts code at 0x23FEB0, no link command writes a PC-chosen address, and HD-TechManager5000 v1.40's ppkn50.dll never sends command 20, so the path is unusable with the surviving firmware/software; the type-6 floppy is the working path. Services 29/30 renamed in the v2.x trees. Website page draft: notes/open4-kn5000-b/hdae/README.md, section 'kn5000-e7f'.
kn5000-mzz: Wave 4 (open4/kn5000-b-hdae): main-board end done, board side BLOCKED. The option connector is MAIN CN6, 70 pins, 'FOR HSO (OPTION)' (wiring diagram II-1/II-2, PDF p. 27; pin list on the MAIN P.C. diagram II-8, PDF p. 30): 16-bit bus D0-D15, A1-A18, RD, WRLL/WRLH, chip selects HSOROM/HSORAM/HDDCS/PPIFCS, HDINT (58), HDRDY (11), IORST, RYBY, plus digital audio (DACCK, BCK, LRCK, D03) and analog supplies. Corrections: the label is HSO, not HSQ; cable W3 (QEXGZA34060B) belongs to CN5, not to the option; the signals are PPIFCS and HDDCS (not PPPCS/HDOCS). Full pin table and website page draft: notes/open4-kn5000-b/hdae/README.md, section 'kn5000-mzz'. BLOCKED: the HD-AE5000 board side needs the board or an HD-AE5000 service manual (not in hand).
kn5000-qnf: Wave 4 (open4/kn5000-b-hdae), repo side done; leave open until the docs lane publishes. Both archived disk sets are Wise installers, unpacked with notes/open4-kn5000-b/hdae/probes/wise_scan.py (scratch only): setup.EXE/W02 = HD-TechManager5000 v1.40 (VB5 program + ppkn50.dll, identical to the committed copy, help files, samples); HDTMD120.EXE/W02 = a different 16-bit KN3000 hard-disk manager (Kn30pp16.dll), not the HD-AE5000's. The export -> command map of ppkn50.dll (probes/ppkn50_command_map.py) covers all exports: 1-11, 13, 14, 16, 17, 18 are sent, 12/15/19/20 never; ppkn50-protocol-analysis.md's wrong command table is corrected. The program keeps the table blocks as Dirblk.dat/Fileblk.dat/Flsblk.dat and backs up songs with a .TTX long-name file each. Limit: the VB5 form logic was not decompiled (no decompiler here); strings and DLL calls are what the write-up uses. Website page draft: notes/open4-kn5000-b/hdae/README.md, section 'kn5000-qnf'.
